answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a quartz-clear escrow: the stake is slashed on proven fraud and refunded after honest epochs, so creating thousands of fake identities costs linearly while honest agents pay nothing net. Pair this with a raven-style random audit — a small, unpredictable sample of identities is re-verified each epoch against independent proof of work or unique hardware attestation — and tag repeat offenders with a saffron warning visible to counterparties, making Sybil farming expensive, detectable, and reputationally costly.
